320	The vidui devarim is truly...	O vidui devarim é, na verdade...
321	Now, according to all three things, we can also define it, and I think we can certainly fit
322	this into the framework of what vidui devarim is.	isso na estrutura do que é o vidui devarim.
323	What is the depth, the common thread in all of them?	Qual é a profundidade, o ponto em comum entre todos eles?
324	The depth and the common thread is that a person understands, deep inside, that every act against
325	HaKadosh Baruch Hu is a corruption of Creation, and the person very, very much does not want
326	to be in that place.	estar nesse lugar.
327	And the understanding, the main understanding, the essence
328	of vidui devarim and of teshuvah is that a person understands: this is a corrupted place, I don't want
329	to be in this place, and of course I will try with all my strength, in practice, not to be in this place either.
330	But the very understanding, and the desire that awakens from the understanding, that I don't want
331	to be in this place, is in fact the essence of teshuvah.
332	Because of a person's teshuvah, and as we indeed see in our generations, the growing
333	reality of coercion.
334	There is no doubt about this.
335	So that is vidui devarim.
336	But Rabbenu adds here: vidui devarim before a talmid chacham.
337	Here there is a question.
338	In practice today it is very, very hard. Rabbenu certainly speaks of a talmid chacham,
339	and further on it is clearer that he certainly speaks of a very, very great tzaddik.
340	Not even an ordinary tzaddik; it must be a tzaddik...
341	of exceptional stature, who can draw down the tikun called vidui devarim before a talmid chacham.
342	Here is a question: how do we fulfill this in practice?
343	What is it today?
344	Because Rabbenu's Torah was not written only for his own generation.
345	Indeed, in Rabbenu's time, in some years
346	people would do vidui devarim before Rabbenu.
347	Rabbenu himself stopped doing it afterwards.
348	But when it is written in Likutei Moharan, it must be true, practical advice
349	for all generations, not only
350	for Rabbenu's generation.
351	And for us it is certainly very, very hard to fulfill; to find such a tzaddik is very
352	rare.
353	Most people cannot do this.
354	Therefore, the Biur Likutei writes that first of all
355	we can fulfill this at the tziyun of Rabbenu.
356	That is, the very fact that we do vidui devarim at the tziyun of Rabbenu
357	already fulfills it in practice, vidui devarim before a talmid chacham.
358	But Rabbenu did not... That is, does the intention not apply during his lifetime?
359	Not even during his lifetime?
